title: Sonate Op. 17
identity: Bernhard Krol's *Sonate*, Op. 17, is published for alto saxophone and piano by Friedrich Hofmeister, item FH 3129. A dealer classifies the score at Level 4. Frank Lunte and Tatjana Blome recorded the work for the EDA anthology *Musik für Saxophon aus Deutschland 1952-1969*; the recording date is listed as approximately 2007.
